facts.text: myoChallengeBaodingP1-v1 is registered with entry point BaodingEnv, model hand/myohand_baoding.xml and max_episode_steps=200
The normalized action space is a symmetric Box from -ones to +ones with one value per actuator
The default observation keys are hand_pos, object1_pos, object1_velp, object2_pos, object2_velp, target1_pos, target2_pos, target1_err and target2_err
act (the muscle activations) is appended to the observation when the model has muscle actuators
hand_pos is qpos[:-14], the hand coordinates before the two balls' free joints; the ball velocities are qvel[-12:-9] and qvel[-6:-3] times the control timestep
target1_err and target2_err are the target position minus the ball position
The observation space is an unbounded Box: the observations are physical quantities with no common bound and are not clipped
step returns the Gymnasium five-tuple and always passes False for truncated; the TimeLimit wrapper owns the step limit
reset restores qpos and qvel from the initial state and returns the observation
The episode is done when a ball's height is below the constructor option drop_th
The MuJoCo model timestep is 0.0025 s
The control timestep is the model timestep times frame_skip
The baoding scene adds one free joint for each of the two balls, after the hand body

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the fake's initial ball offset and its later steps are a deterministic function of the action; the fake uses Python's random.Random, not the upstream environment's numpy generator, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on both

gaps: no dynamics: the fake backend is a kinematic stand-in that moves two ball coordinates by a fixed placeholder response; no MuJoCo integration, contacts, tendons, muscles or actuator forces are modelled

the observation vector has the real shape (hand coordinates, two ball positions and velocities, two target positions and errors, muscle activations) but placeholder values; it is not comparable with a MyoSuite rollout
the nominal control interval is 25 ms (model timestep 0.0025 s times frame_skip 10); a deployment that overrides frame_skip changes it
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment; MyoSuite, MuJoCo and gymnasium were not importable where the gate ran
the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered environment) was not run: it needs the upstream package, MuJoCo and its assets
no rendering and no snapshot or restore: the bridge leaves cap.world.render.v1 unbound and the fake exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the runtime latches and refuses step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears it; the last observation stays readable and no native stop exists because the device is simulated
